transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

Well, I came in because... I just feel wound up almost all the time. It's like my body is constantly bracing for the next bad thing to happen. Even when I'm just sitting at my desk working, or trying to enjoy a dance night, I have this tension I can't shake.
Have you gone through a traumatic event that still affects you?

No, not really. I mean... I haven't been through anything major like a bad accident or, you know, anything you'd call a trauma. My life has actually been pretty normal. That's kind of why I don't really understand why I feel so on edge all the time.
Do you feel especially anxious in social situations where other people might be watching or judging you?

No, I don't think so. It's not really about other people watching me or judging me. Like I mentioned with dance nights, I actually like being around people. The tension is just... it's just always there, even when I'm completely alone at my computer. So it doesn't really seem tied to social situations.
Do you find yourself worrying a lot about different parts of your life, even when there isn’t a clear reason to?

Yeah, I really do. It used to just be about my condo, but my worry doesn't stay on that anymore. It just jumps around all over the place. I'll be worrying about whether my cousin is upset with me, and then it shifts to whether I'll make a mistake on a support call at work. Or I'll start stressing about how I'll ever save money or move forward with my life. It's just a constant cycle of different things, even when nothing is actually going wrong.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?

No, not really. I mean, I don't feel sad or hopeless or anything like that. It's really just the constant worrying and feeling tense all the time. I'm not depressed, just... stressed out and anxious about everything.
Has this kind of excessive worry been happening on most days for at least six months?

Yeah, it's definitely been more than six months. Um, I'd say it's been going on for about nine months now. It really started back when my condo loan started moving toward foreclosure, and it's just been pretty much every day since then.
